articles.title: DoorDash is acquiring Instacart for around $17 billion
articles.description: DoorDash has announced that it's buying Instacart in a deal valued at approximately $17 billion. The acquisition will give DoorDash a bigger presence in online grocery delivery via Instacart's established grocery marketplace and retailer partnerships. DoorDash, which started as a restaurant courier service, already has its own grocery delivery business, but that faces ongoing competition […]
articles.author: Jess Weatherbed

articles.title: Anduril now says its BlueChip laptop will meet Buy American standards at launch
articles.description: On Tuesday, defense contractor Anduril and chipmaker Qualcomm announced a partnership to build laptops entirely in the United States, starting with a single model in 2027.
